# Import pollen counts and calculate percentages
```{r}
# Load packages used in the analysis
library(readxl)
library(vegan)
library(rioja)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(iNEXT)
library(viridisLite)
library(writexl)
library(grid)
library(readr)

my_count <- read_excel("my samples count done.xlsx",sheet = "my count",range = "A1:AA67",col_names = FALSE)

sample_names <- as.character(unlist(my_count[1, -1])) #sample names row 1
depth_midpoint_spore <- as.numeric(unlist(my_count[3, -1])) #depth midpoints row 3
names(depth_midpoint_spore) <- sample_names #Match

taxon_counts <- as.data.frame(my_count[7:67, -1])#taxa in rows 7–67
rownames(taxon_counts) <- as.character(unlist(my_count[7:67, 1]))
colnames(taxon_counts) <- sample_names #Assign taxon names and sample names
taxon_counts[] <- lapply(taxon_counts, as.numeric)#make sure numeric values
```

```{r}
# Exclude these taxa from the main pollen and spore sum (ΣP)
excluded_from_main_sum <- c("Dryopteris-type", "Sphagnum", "Lycopodium counted", "Unknown")
all_counts <- as.data.frame(t(taxon_counts))
main_pollen_spore_counts <- all_counts[
  , !names(all_counts) %in% excluded_from_main_sum,
  drop = FALSE]

# Match sediment depth midpoints to the sample order and make sum for each
depth_spore <- as.numeric(depth_midpoint_spore[rownames(main_pollen_spore_counts)])
pollen_spore_sums <- rowSums(main_pollen_spore_counts)

# Calculate percentages for all taxa included in the main sum
pollen_spore_percentage <- main_pollen_spore_counts |>
  sweep(1, pollen_spore_sums, "/") * 100

# Calculate Dryopteris-type percentage using ΣP + Dryopteris-type
dryopteris_counts <- all_counts[["Dryopteris-type"]]
dryopteris_percentage <- dryopteris_counts /
  (pollen_spore_sums + dryopteris_counts) * 100

# Calculate Sphagnum percentage using ΣP + Sphagnum
sphagnum_counts <- all_counts[["Sphagnum"]]
sphagnum_percentage <- sphagnum_counts /
  (pollen_spore_sums + sphagnum_counts) * 100

# Add Dryopteris-type and Sphagnum to the percentage table so they can be displayed but do not contribute to ΣP
pollen_spore_percentage[["Dryopteris-type"]] <- dryopteris_percentage
pollen_spore_percentage[["Sphagnum"]] <- sphagnum_percentage
```

## Import ages from PLUM model, make sure correct version

```{r}
pollen_ages <- read.csv("Plum_runs/pollen_sample_ages.csv")#Import ages

age_spore <- pollen_ages$median_cal_yr_BP[match(rownames(main_pollen_spore_counts), as.character(pollen_ages$sample))]#Match ages to samples

# Display sample depths and corresponding modelled ages
age_depth_table <- data.frame(sample = rownames(main_pollen_spore_counts),
  depth_cm = depth_spore,median_cal_yr_BP = age_spore)

print(age_depth_table)
```

# Loss-on-ignition (LOI)

```{r}
loi_raw <- read_excel("glødetap.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1") |>
  transmute(
    beaker_nr = as.character(`beaker nr`),
    dry_g = as.numeric(`beaker+dry`) - as.numeric(beaker),
    ash_g = as.numeric(`beaker+burnt`) - as.numeric(beaker)
  ) |>
  mutate(LOI_percent = (dry_g - ash_g) / dry_g * 100)

pollen_ids <- rownames(main_pollen_spore_counts)#Match values to pollen samples
LOI_spore_plot <- loi_raw$LOI_percent[match(pollen_ids, loi_raw$beaker_nr)]

names(LOI_spore_plot) <- pollen_ids
```

# Charcoal counts

```{r}
charcoal_raw <- read_excel("charcoal.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1") |>
  transmute(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    charcoal_3T = as.numeric(charcoal),
    lycopodium_3T = as.numeric(lycopodium),
    lycopodium_full = as.numeric(`pollen lycopodium`)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Adjust charcoal counts to the full pollen counting effort
    charcoal_adjusted = charcoal_3T * lycopodium_full / lycopodium_3T
  )

charcoal_spore_plot <- charcoal_raw$charcoal_adjusted[match(pollen_ids, charcoal_raw$sample)]#Match adjusted charcoal values to pollen samples
names(charcoal_spore_plot) <- pollen_ids 
#Assign sample names to the adjusted values and check on original and adjusted values for each pollen sample
charcoal_mapping_check <- charcoal_raw[match(pollen_ids, charcoal_raw$sample),]
print(charcoal_mapping_check)
# Identify samples with fewer than 20 Lycopodium spores in three transects
# These adjusted values may be sensitive to small counting differences
low_lyco_charcoal <- charcoal_mapping_check |>filter(lycopodium_3T < 20 | !is.finite(charcoal_adjusted))
print(low_lyco_charcoal)
```

# Ordination: DCA and PCA

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-align: center

# Use all taxa in the main pollen and spore assemblage
ordination_data <- main_pollen_spore_counts
# percentages for DCA
ordination_percent <- decostand(ordination_data, "total") * 100 
dca_model <- decorana(ordination_percent)
print(dca_model) # Display DCA results

# Hellinger-transform the assemblage before PCA
ordination_hellinger <- decostand(ordination_data, "hellinger")
pca_model <- prcomp(ordination_hellinger)

# Calculate percentage of variance explained by each PCA axis
pca_variance <- 100 * pca_model$sdev^2 / sum(pca_model$sdev^2)
print(round(pca_variance[1:2], 2))# Display

# DCA PLOT, Extract taxon scores for the first two DCA axes
dca_taxa <- as.data.frame(
  scores(dca_model, display = "species", choices = 1:2)
)
colnames(dca_taxa) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
dca_taxa$Taxon <- rownames(dca_taxa)

# Label the 15 taxa furthest from the origin
top_dca_taxa <- dca_taxa |>
  mutate(distance = sqrt(Axis1^2 + Axis2^2)) |>
  slice_max(distance, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE)

# Plot all taxa, highlighting and labelling the 15 most extreme
fig_dca_percent <- ggplot(dca_taxa, aes(Axis1, Axis2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey75") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey75") +
  geom_point(colour = "grey65", size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = top_dca_taxa, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = top_dca_taxa,aes(label = Taxon),size = 3.5,seed = 123,
    max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(title = "DCA – pollen and spore percentages",
    subtitle = "All taxa in the main sum; 15 most extreme taxa labelled",
    x = "DCA1",y = "DCA2") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

# PCA PLOT, Extract sample scores for PCA1 and PCA2
pca_diagram_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_model$x[, 1:2])
colnames(pca_diagram_scores) <- c("PCA1", "PCA2")

pca_samples <- pca_diagram_scores
pca_samples$Depth_cm <- as.character(depth_midpoint_spore[rownames(pca_samples)])#sediment depth midpoint for each sample

pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_model$rotation[, 1:2])#Extract taxon loadings for PCA1 and PCA2
colnames(pca_loadings) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
pca_loadings$Taxon <- rownames(pca_loadings)

# Select the 15 taxa with the largest loading-vector lengths
pca_loadings <- pca_loadings |>
  mutate(distance = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)) |>
  slice_max(distance, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE)

# Scale taxon arrows to fit alongside the sample scores
# This changes arrow display lengths, not the PCA calculations
arrow_scale <- 0.75 *
  max(abs(as.matrix(pca_samples[, c("PCA1", "PCA2")]))) /
  max(abs(as.matrix(pca_loadings[, c("PC1", "PC2")])))

pca_loadings <- pca_loadings |>mutate(arrow_x = PC1 * arrow_scale,
    arrow_y = PC2 * arrow_scale)

# Plot sample scores and taxon loading arrows
fig_pca_depth <- ggplot(pca_samples, aes(PCA1, PCA2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey75") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey75") +
  geom_point(size = 1.7) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Depth_cm),size = 3,seed = 123,max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0) +
  geom_segment(data = pca_loadings,aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = arrow_x, yend = arrow_y),inherit.aes = FALSE,colour = "firebrick",arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.16, "cm"))
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(data = pca_loadings,aes(x = arrow_x, y = arrow_y, label = Taxon),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,colour = "firebrick",size = 3,seed = 123,max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  labs(title = "PCA biplot – Trettetjørn",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_variance[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_variance[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

print(fig_dca_percent)
print(fig_pca_depth)
```

```{r}
pca_loadings_all <- pca_model$rotation[, 1:2]#PCA1 and PCA2 loadings

#Calculate each taxon's percentage contribution
taxon_contributions <- data.frame(Taxon = rownames(pca_loadings_all),
  PC1_contribution = 100 * pca_loadings_all[, 1]^2,
  PC2_contribution = 100 * pca_loadings_all[, 2]^2)

top_PC1 <- taxon_contributions |>arrange(desc(PC1_contribution)) |>head(15)
top_PC2 <- taxon_contributions |>arrange(desc(PC2_contribution)) |>head(15)

print(top_PC1)
print(top_PC2)
```

## Rarefaction curves

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
#| 
sample_colours_spore <- viridis(nrow(main_pollen_spore_counts))

# Plot expected taxon richness against the number of grains counted
rarecurve(main_pollen_spore_counts,step = 10,col = sample_colours_spore,
  lwd = 2,label = FALSE,xlab = "Pollen + spores counted",ylab = "Expected pollen + spore taxa")

# Mark the chosen standardisation threshold of 278 grains
abline(v = 278,col = "grey35",lty = 2,lwd = 1.5)
```

## N0 rarified curve for diagram

```{r}
rarefaction_level <- 278

# only samples with at least 278, goodbye 1, 2 and 26
pollen_spore_counts_filtered <- main_pollen_spore_counts[rowSums(main_pollen_spore_counts) >= rarefaction_level,,drop = FALSE]

# Calculate expected taxon richness (N0) at 278 grains
N0_spore_rarefied <- rarefy(pollen_spore_counts_filtered,sample = rarefaction_level)
print(N0_spore_rarefied)
```

## Graph rarefied at 278 for all hill numbers

```{r}
# Convert the retained pollen and spore samples into a list for iNEXT
pollen_spore_list_278 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pollen_spore_counts_filtered)),
  function(i) as.numeric(pollen_spore_counts_filtered[i, ]))

names(pollen_spore_list_278) <- rownames(pollen_spore_counts_filtered)

# Calculate Hill diversity (N0, N1 and N2) at 278 grains
hill_spore_278 <- estimateD(pollen_spore_list_278,datatype = "abundance",
  base = "size",level = rarefaction_level,q = c(0, 1, 2)) |>
  mutate(
    # Match modelled ages to sample IDs
    Age_cal_yr_BP = age_depth_table$median_cal_yr_BP[
      match(as.character(Assemblage), age_depth_table$sample)]) |>
  arrange(Age_cal_yr_BP, Order.q)

# Calculate evenness as the ratio of N2 to N1
evenness_278 <- hill_spore_278 |>select(Assemblage, Order.q, qD) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Order.q,values_from = qD,names_prefix = "N") |>
  mutate(Evenness_N2_N1 = N2 / N1,Age_cal_yr_BP = age_depth_table$median_cal_yr_BP[
      match(as.character(Assemblage), age_depth_table$sample)])

print(evenness_278)
```

## Plot over time

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 9

# Prepare Hill diversity data at 278 grains
hill_plot_278 <- hill_spore_278 |>mutate(Diversity = factor(
      Order.q,levels = c(0, 1, 2),labels = c(
        "N0 – Richness",
        "N1 – Shannon",
        "N2 – Simpson")
      )) |>arrange(Age_cal_yr_BP, Order.q)

ggplot(hill_plot_278,aes(x = Age_cal_yr_BP,y = qD,colour = Diversity,linetype = Diversity,group = Diversity)) +
  # Connect individual sample values
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  # GAM smooth for each diversity measure
  geom_smooth(method = "gam",formula = y ~ s(x, k = 5),se = TRUE,linewidth = 1) +
  
  scale_colour_grey(start = 0,end = 0.7) +  # Greyscale
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid","dashed","dotted")) +
  coord_flip() +   # Flip so age is vertical
  scale_x_reverse(
    breaks = seq(0, 500, 100)
  )+  # Older ages at the bottom
  labs(title = "Rarefied pollen and spore diversity",
    x = "Age (cal yr BP)", y = "Effective number of taxa",colour = "Hill number",
    linetype = "Hill number") +
  
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
library(mgcv)

richness_data <- hill_spore_278 |> filter(Order.q == 2)
richness_gam <- gam(qD ~ s(Age_cal_yr_BP, k = 5),data = richness_data,method = "REML")
summary(richness_gam)
```

```{r}
gam.check(richness_gam)
```

```{r}
  shrub = "#598DBB",
  dwarf_shrub = "#9900FF",
  graminoid = "goldenrod2",
  forb = "#D81B4C",
  spore = "#5E9E21",
  other = "grey40"
)
curve_colours_spore <- unname(group_colours[group_vec_spore])

# Match all supplementary variables to pollen sample order
sample_ids <- rownames(pollen_spore_percentage)

div_spore <- data.frame(
  N0_rarefied = as.numeric(N0_spore_rarefied[sample_ids]),
  PCA1 = pca_diagram_scores[sample_ids, "PCA1"],
  PCA2 = pca_diagram_scores[sample_ids, "PCA2"],
  "LOI (%)" = as.numeric(LOI_spore_plot[sample_ids]),
  "Charcoal (adjusted)" = as.numeric(charcoal_spore_plot[sample_ids]),
  row.names = sample_ids,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Match modelled median ages to the pollen diagram samples
age_diagram_spore <- age_depth_table$median_cal_yr_BP[
  match(sample_ids, age_depth_table$sample)]
```

## Diagram printed — pollen sum and vegetation zones

The broken-stick assessment supports two main CONISS groups, with the main boundary near 8 cm. The lower interval is subdivided descriptively at 14 cm into TRET1A and TRET1B.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 7
# Main pollen and spore sum for each sample
sum_grains_diagram <- as.numeric(pollen_spore_sums[sample_ids])

# Vegetation zone boundaries (cm) and labels
zone_boundaries_cm <- c(8, 14)
zone_names <- c("TRET2", "TRET1B", "TRET1A")

# Figure layout
pollen_panel_limits <- c(0.12, 0.61)
diversity_panel_limits <- c(0.62, 0.85)
panel_y_limits <- c(0.06, 0.82)

# Colours for diversity and environmental curves
div_colours <- c(
  "grey35",      # Rarefied richness (N0)
  "firebrick4",  # PCA1
  "firebrick4",  # PCA2
  "grey35",      # LOI
  "black"        # Adjusted charcoal
)

# Convert zone boundaries from depth (cm) to modelled age
boundary_ages <- approx(
  x = depth_diagram_spore,
  y = age_diagram_spore,
  xout = zone_boundaries_cm
)$y

# SECONDARY DEPTH AXIS
secondary.scale <- function() {
  
  oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(oldpar))
  
  par(fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1),mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0),new = TRUE,xpd = NA)
  
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim = c(0, 1),ylim = c(0, 1),xaxs = "i",yaxs = "i")
  
# Convert modelled ages to vertical figure positions
age_to_y <- function(age) {
  panel_y_limits[2] -
    (age - min(age_diagram_spore)) /
    diff(range(age_diagram_spore)) *
    diff(panel_y_limits)
  }
  
  y <- age_to_y(age_diagram_spore)
  x_left <- 0.080
  
segments(x_left, min(y),x_left, max(y),col = "grey35")#Draw the depth axis
segments(x_left - 0.004, y,x_left, y,col = "grey35")#Draw depth tick marks
  
text(x_left - 0.007,y,labels = sprintf("%.1f", depth_diagram_spore),adj = 1,
    cex = 0.62)#Label each sample depth
text(x_left - 0.030,mean(range(y)),"Depth (cm)",srt = 90,cex = 0.8)}#Label the depth axis

# POLLEN SUM AND VEGETATION ZONES
add_pollen_sum_and_zones <- function() {
  oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(oldpar))
   par(
    fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1),
    mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
    new = TRUE,
    xpd = NA)
  
  plot.new()
  plot.window(
    xlim = c(0, 1),
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i" )
  
  # Convert ages to vertical figure positions
  age_to_y <- function(age) {
    panel_y_limits[2] -
      (age - min(age_diagram_spore)) /
      diff(range(age_diagram_spore)) *
      diff(panel_y_limits)}
  
  # Positions of the grain-count and zone columns
  grain_left <- 0.863
  grain_right <- 0.900
  grain_centre <- 0.882
  zone_centre <- 0.920
  
  # Draw grain-count column boundaries
  segments(
    c(grain_left, grain_right),
    panel_y_limits[1],
    c(grain_left, grain_right),
    panel_y_limits[2],
    col = "grey65")
  
  # Column headings
  text(grain_centre, 0.855, "Main sum grains", cex = 0.55)
  text(zone_centre, 0.855, "Zone", cex = 0.65)
  
  # Show the main pollen and spore sum for each sample
  text(
    grain_centre,
    age_to_y(age_diagram_spore),
    labels = sum_grains_diagram,
    cex = 0.56)
  
  # Draw vegetation zone boundaries
  boundary_y <- age_to_y(boundary_ages)
  
  segments(
    0.12, boundary_y,
    0.955, boundary_y,
    col = "grey40",
    lty = 2,
    lwd = 1.2)
  
  # Position zone labels between boundaries
  zone_edges <- c(
    panel_y_limits[2],
    boundary_y,
    panel_y_limits[1])
  
  zone_centres <- (
    zone_edges[-1] +
      zone_edges[-length(zone_edges)]) / 2
  
  text(
    zone_centre,
    zone_centres,
    zone_names,
    cex = 0.83)}

# MAIN POLLEN DIAGRAM
make_pollen_diagram <- function() {
 
# Plot pollen and spore percentages
  pollen_spore_diagram <- strat.plot(
    pollen_spore_percentage_subset,
    yvar = age_diagram_spore,
    y.rev = TRUE,
    y.tks = sort(unique(c(
      floor(min(age_diagram_spore)),
      seq(0, 600, 100),
      ceiling(max(age_diagram_spore))
    ))),
    plot.poly = TRUE,
    col.poly = curve_colours_spore,
    scale.percent = TRUE,
    las = 2,
    exag = exaggerate_spore,
    col.exag = "grey55",
    exag.alpha = 0.45,
    exag.mult = 5,
    srt.xlabel = 45,
    cex.xlabel = 0.70,
    ylabel = "Age (cal yr BP)",
    ylabPos = 2.25,
    xLeft = pollen_panel_limits[1],
    xRight = pollen_panel_limits[2],
    yBottom = panel_y_limits[1],
    yTop = panel_y_limits[2],
    wa.order = "none",
    title = "")
  
  # Plot rarefied richness, PCA, LOI, charcoal and CONISS
  diversity_spore_diagram <- strat.plot(
    div_spore,
    yvar = age_diagram_spore,
    y.rev = TRUE,
    y.axis = FALSE,
    plot.line = TRUE,
    plot.poly = FALSE,
    plot.bar = FALSE,
    col.line = div_colours,
    lwd.line = 2,
    xLeft = diversity_panel_limits[1],
    xRight = diversity_panel_limits[2],
    yBottom = panel_y_limits[1],
    yTop = panel_y_limits[2],
    srt.xlabel = 45,
    cex.xlabel = 0.75,
    add = TRUE,
    clust = coniss_model,
    clust.width = 0.06)
  
  add_pollen_sum_and_zones()# Add pollen sum and vegetation zones
  secondary.scale()  # Add the sediment depth axis
  
  invisible(list(pollen = pollen_spore_diagram,diversity = diversity_spore_diagram))}
make_pollen_diagram()#Display
```

```{r}

#| label: fig-terrestrial-pollen-groups
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7

# Combine the existing functional groups into four vegetation groups
group_class <- taxon_groups
group_class[group_class == "tree"] <- "Trees"
group_class[group_class == "shrub"] <- "Shrubs"
group_class[group_class == "dwarf_shrub"] <- "Dwarf shrubs"
group_class[group_class %in% c("graminoid", "forb")] <- "Herbs"

# Set the order of vegetation groups in the figure
groups <- c("Herbs", "Dwarf shrubs", "Shrubs", "Trees")

# Select terrestrial pollen taxa from the main pollen and spore counts
pollen_taxa <- intersect(
  names(group_class)[group_class %in% groups],
  colnames(main_pollen_spore_counts))
counts <- main_pollen_spore_counts[, pollen_taxa, drop = FALSE]

# Sum the counts belonging to each vegetation group
group_counts <- sapply(groups, \(g) {
  rowSums(counts[, group_class[pollen_taxa] == g, drop = FALSE])})

# Express each vegetation group as a percentage of classified terrestrial pollen
group_percent <- 100 * group_counts / rowSums(group_counts)

# Match sample depths and modelled ages to the vegetation-group data
sample_info <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(group_percent),
  Depth = as.numeric(depth_midpoint_spore[rownames(group_percent)]),
  Age = age_depth_table$median_cal_yr_BP[
    match(rownames(group_percent), age_depth_table$sample)])

# Prepare vegetation-group percentages for the stacked diagram
summary_long <- as.data.frame(group_percent) |>
  mutate(Sample = rownames(group_percent)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(groups),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Percent"
  ) |>
  left_join(sample_info, by = "Sample") |>
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = groups)) |>
  arrange(Depth, Group) |>
  group_by(Depth) |>
  mutate(
    xmax = cumsum(Percent),
    xmin = xmax - Percent
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Calculate label positions between vegetation-zone boundaries
zone_edges_cm <- c(
  min(sample_info$Depth),
  zone_boundaries_cm,
  max(sample_info$Depth))

zone_labels <- data.frame(
  Zone = zone_names,
  Depth = (
    zone_edges_cm[-1] +
      zone_edges_cm[-length(zone_edges_cm)] ) / 2)

# Plot
vegetation_group_figure <- ggplot(
  summary_long,aes(x = Depth,ymin = xmin,ymax = xmax,fill = Group,group = Group)) +
  geom_ribbon(colour = NA) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = zone_boundaries_cm,# Mark vegetation-zone boundaries
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(
    data = sample_info, # Add sample depth labels
    aes(x = Depth, y = -12, label = Depth),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.8) +
geom_text(
    data = sample_info,  # Add modelled sample ages
    aes(x = Depth, y = -5, label = round(Age)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = zone_labels, # Add vegetation-zone names
    aes(x = Depth, y = 104, label = Zone),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3) +
   geom_hline(yintercept = c(-8.5, -1), linewidth = 0.4) + # Separate the age and depth label columns
  
  # Display depth vertically, increasing downwards
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_x_reverse(
    limits = c(max(sample_info$Depth), min(sample_info$Depth)),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-15, 110),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  
  # Colours for the four vegetation groups
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Herbs" = "#C38CF5","Dwarf shrubs" = "#3100B0","Shrubs" = "#598FBD","Trees" = "#005544"
  )) +
  
  labs(x = NULL,y = "Terrestrial pollen group (%)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank())

print(vegetation_group_figure)
```

Pollen influx diagram

Influx/PAR is an absolute measure. The percentage denominators used for the pollen diagram are therefore NOT used here.. Dryopteris-type is calculated like any other taxon. Sphagnum is kept separate from the main pollen + spore influx diagram for consistency with the percentage diagram.

```{r}
# Exclude marker spores, unknown counts and Sphagnum from the influx dataset
excluded_from_influx <- c("Lycopodium counted","Unknown","Sphagnum")

# Use raw pollen and spore counts, including Dryopteris-type
influx_counts_all <- all_counts[
  , !colnames(all_counts) %in% excluded_from_influx,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Select the taxa displayed in the main percentage diagram
influx_taxa <- intersect(colnames(pollen_spore_percentage_subset),
  colnames(influx_counts_all))

# Keep raw counts for the individually displayed taxa
influx_counts <- influx_counts_all[, influx_taxa,drop = FALSE]

# Calculate total counts across all retained pollen and spore taxa
total_pollen_spore_counts <- rowSums(influx_counts_all)

```

## calculate spore + pollen influx

```{r}

# Lycopodium tablet information and sediment volume
lycopodium_per_tablet <- 18584

tablets_added <- setNames(as.numeric(unlist(my_count[4, -1])),sample_names)
sediment_volume <- setNames(as.numeric(unlist(my_count[5, -1])),sample_names)
lycopodium_counted <- setNames(as.numeric(unlist(my_count[6, -1])),sample_names)

# Arrange samples from shallowest to deepest
samples <- rownames(influx_counts_all)
samples <- samples[order(depth_midpoint_spore[samples])]
depth_influx <- depth_midpoint_spore[samples]

# Match modelled median ages to the ordered samples
age_influx <- age_depth_table$median_cal_yr_BP[match(samples, age_depth_table$sample)]
names(age_influx) <- samples

# Calculate sediment accumulation rate between adjacent samples (cm/year)
interval_sar <- diff(depth_influx) / diff(age_influx)

# Assign a sediment accumulation rate to each sample
# Interior samples receive the mean of the adjacent interval rates
sar_cm_yr <- c(
  interval_sar[1],
  (head(interval_sar, -1) + tail(interval_sar, -1)) / 2,
  tail(interval_sar, 1)
)

names(sar_cm_yr) <- samples

# Calculate the Lycopodium-based concentration correction
concentration_factor <- (
  tablets_added[samples] * lycopodium_per_tablet
) / (
  lycopodium_counted[samples] * sediment_volume[samples]
)

# Calculate individual taxon concentrations (grains/cm³)
taxon_concentration <- sweep(
  as.matrix(influx_counts[samples, , drop = FALSE]),
  1,
  concentration_factor,
  "*"
)

# Calculate individual taxon influx (grains/cm²/year)
taxon_influx <- sweep(
  taxon_concentration,
  1,
  sar_cm_yr,
  "*"
)

# Calculate total pollen and spore influx
total_pollen_spore_influx <- (
  total_pollen_spore_counts[samples] *
    concentration_factor *
    sar_cm_yr
)

# Summarise the influx calculations for each sample
influx_summary <- data.frame(
  Sample = samples,
  Depth_cm = as.numeric(depth_influx),
  Age_cal_BP = as.numeric(age_influx),
  SAR_cm_yr = as.numeric(sar_cm_yr),
  Total_influx = as.numeric(total_pollen_spore_influx)
)

print(influx_summary)
```

```{r}
# Add vegetation-zone boundaries and labels to the influx diagram
add_influx_zones <- function() {
  
  oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit(par(oldpar))
  
  # Create an overlay covering the full figure
  par(
    fig = c(0, 1, 0, 1),
    mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
    oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
    new = TRUE,
    xpd = NA
  )
  
  plot.new()
  plot.window(
    xlim = c(0, 1),
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i"
  )
  
  # Draw the divider before the zone column
  segments(
    0.90, panel_y_limits[1],
    0.90, panel_y_limits[2],
    col = "grey65"
  )
  
  # Add the zone column heading
  text(0.95, 0.855, "Zone", cex = 0.7)
  
  # Convert zone boundary ages to figure positions
  boundary_y <- panel_y_limits[2] -
    (boundary_ages - min(age_diagram_spore)) /
    diff(range(age_diagram_spore)) *
    diff(panel_y_limits)
  
  # Draw horizontal zone boundaries
  segments(
    0.12, boundary_y,
    0.995, boundary_y,
    col = "grey40",
    lty = 2,
    lwd = 1.2
  )
  
  # Calculate the centre of each vegetation zone
  zone_edges <- c(
    panel_y_limits[2],
    boundary_y,
    panel_y_limits[1]
  )
  
  zone_centres <- (
    head(zone_edges, -1) +
      tail(zone_edges, -1)
  ) / 2
  
  # Add zone labels
  text(
    0.95,
    zone_centres,
    labels = zone_names,
    cex = 0.83
  )
}
```

```{r}
  strat.plot(
    influx_plot,
    yvar = age_diagram_spore,
    y.rev = TRUE,
    y.tks = sort(unique(c(
      floor(min(age_diagram_spore)),
      seq(0, 600, 100),
      ceiling(max(age_diagram_spore))
    ))),
    plot.line = TRUE,
    plot.poly = TRUE,
    plot.bar = FALSE,
```
